$comment: Canonical adapter channel authentication vectors. Every implementation of the local adapter contract, in any language, must reproduce these bytes exactly. Values are lowercase hex.
encodingLayout: protocol version as two big-endian bytes
profile length as two big-endian bytes, then the profile bytes
consumer length as two big-endian bytes, then the consumer bytes
proofLayout: HMAC-SHA-256 over the 32-byte role domain followed by the encoded transcript, keyed by the launch capability
